# Nubezón

**Status: DRAFT** · world: [erid](../lore/worlds/erid.md) · kind: new · stage: space · id: `nubezon`

## Niche

- **Habitat:** Upper haze layer (15-25 km altitude), drifting on thermal tides
- **Diet:** Electrostatically charged tholin particulates, dissolved ammonia vapor
- **Active:** Perpetual; pulses rhythmically to regulate buoyancy
- **Predators:** none

## Body

Enormous gas-filled hydrocarbon bladder, suspended tethers of woven keratin-analogue, skin laminated with conductive Fe-Ni dust

**Temperament:** Placid drifter; defensive via high-voltage arc and acoustic thrumming
